mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending confidence and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in a month, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate earnings growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month
failure_condition: In periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector weakness, increasing recession risks and causing S&P 500 underperformance over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above its 3-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and non-farm payrolls declines indicate severe labor market deterioration, reducing household income and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines from prior month
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines from prior month, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector strength, improving economic conditions and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods.
